query:
SELECT p.actor_id
        FROM permissions p
        JOIN actors a ON a.id = p.actor_id
        WHERE p.community_id = $1
          AND p.scope = 'community'::permission_scope
          AND p.actor_id <> $2
          AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY p.granted_at ASC, p.actor_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
